response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior individual contributor with solid full-stack and some distributed-systems background, but the resume shows no executive or people-leadership experience, no track record scaling engineering teams, and no demonstrated production multi-agent AI systems in regulated environments. His AI-agent exposure appears recent and tooling-focused (MCP generators) rather than architecting stateful agentic platforms, and fintech exposure is limited to a brief IC stint at RIDE Capital. He does not meet the hard requirements for a CTO role of this scope.
strengths: Broad, hands-on engineering experience across backend, event-driven systems, and low-latency microservices (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/workshop experience
concerns: No senior technical-leadership or team-scaling experience (10→30+), which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or real-time inference architecture at depth
Minimal fintech-infrastructure depth (credit systems, exposure modeling, multi-jurisdiction compliance)
